You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 2 of 50 (script duration 110.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
Direct lead-in to E2: Picks up directly from Episode 1's cliffhanger. Gerald has turned away from Juliana at the altar, leaving her devastated before the entire aristocratic congregation.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-2.8] SCREEN: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.
[L002 0.0-2.5] THE FORMER GROOM (Cold, Callous): "I cannot marry you, Juliana."
[L003 2.8-4.6] SCREEN: Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.
[L004 2.8-4.6] ACTION: Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.
[L005 4.6-6.6] SCREEN: Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.
[L006 4.7-6.5] THE FORMER GROOM (Cruel, Derisive): "You are far too plain..."
[L007 6.6-9.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.
[L008 6.8-9.5] THE FORMER GROOM (Off-screen, Dismissive): "...far too silent..."
[L009 9.5-12.0] SCREEN: Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.
[L010 9.6-12.0] THE FORMER GROOM (Arrogant, Conceited): "...and completely beneath the future I deserve."
[L011 12.0-15.8] SCREEN: Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.
[L012 12.4-15.5] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Pleading): "Gerald... Look at me."
[L013 15.8-18.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.
[L014 18.0-20.7] SCREEN: Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.
[L015 18.2-20.6] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Betrayed): "You gave me your word before both our families."
[L016 20.7-23.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.
[L017 20.9-23.7] THE FORMER GROOM (Indifferent, Unapologetic): "Promises change when a better choice appears."
[L018 23.8-27.6] SCREEN: Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.
[L019 24.0-27.4] LADY JULIANA (Shattered, Disbelieving): "A better choice? Is that what she is?"
[L020 27.6-30.6] SCREEN: Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.
[L021 27.8-30.5] THE FORMER GROOM (Resolute, Harsh): "She is what I should have chosen from the beginning."
[L022 30.6-32.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.
[L023 30.9-32.4] LADY JULIANA (Off-screen, Vulnerable, Begging): "Father..."
[L024 32.4-34.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
[L025 34.2-37.2] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.
[L026 34.3-37.1] LADY JULIANA (Choked with Tears): "Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?"
[L027 37.2-42.5] SCREEN: Medium shot tracking in on Juliana's father as he leans firmly upon his cane, looking down coldly.
[L028 37.5-42.3] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Stern, Cold): "Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana."
[L029 42.5-44.8] SCREEN: Close-up on the father's hardening eyes, entirely unsympathetic.
[L030 42.5-44.7] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Severely, Harsh): "Do not disgrace us further."
[L031 44.8-47.6] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.
[L032 45.3-47.4] LADY JULIANA (Whispering, Crushed): "You won't even look at me."
[L033 47.6-51.5] SCREEN: Medium shot on Clarissa, beaming smugly as she clings to Gerald's arm.
[L034 47.8-51.4] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking, Spiteful): "Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you."
[L035 51.5-53.4] SCREEN: Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.
[L036 51.6-53.2] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Off-screen, Scornful): "That plain, old-fashioned gown."
[L037 53.4-56.7] SCREEN: Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.
[L038 53.5-56.7] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Taunting, Giggling): "You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding."
[L039 56.7-58.2] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.
[L040 56.8-58.2] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Off-screen, Snide): "And that quiet little face."
[L041 58.2-58.6] SCREEN: Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.
[L042 58.6-60.5] SCREEN: Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.
[L043 58.7-60.5] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Conceited, Spiteful): "Gerald needs a real lady..."
[L044 60.5-63.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.
[L045 60.6-63.5] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Off-screen, Vicious): "...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs."
[L046 63.5-66.0] SCREEN: High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
[L047 63.5-66.0] ACTION: The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.
[L048 63.6-65.8] OFF-SCREEN VOICE (Cold, Scolding): "Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana."
[L049 66.0-69.3] SCREEN: Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.
[L050 66.1-69.3] OFF-SCREEN VOICE (Dismissive, Condescending): "You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding."
[L051 69.3-72.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.
[L052 69.4-72.7] THE FORMER GROOM (Impatient, Commanding): "Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity."
[L053 72.8-74.2] SCREEN: Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
[L054 74.2-76.5] SCREEN: Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.
[L055 74.4-76.4] LADY JULIANA (Bitter, Defiant): "Dignity?"
[L056 76.5-79.0] SCREEN: Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.
[L057 76.5-79.0] LADY JULIANA (Clear, Accusing): "You abandoned a woman who trusted you..."
[L058 79.0-81.8] SCREEN: Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.
[L059 79.2-82.5] LADY JULIANA (Off-screen, Sharp, Piercing): "...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth."
[L060 81.8-82.8] SCREEN: Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.
[L061 82.8-86.7] SCREEN: Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.
[L062 83.0-86.5] LADY JULIANA (Steely, Resolute): "Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald."
[L063 86.7-90.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.
[L064 86.8-93.0] LADY JULIANA (Powerful, Unyielding): "You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable."
[L065 90.8-93.2] SCREEN: Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.
[L066 93.2-96.8] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.
[L067 93.4-96.6] LADY JULIANA (Decisive, Scathing): "You have shown them exactly what your word is worth."
[L068 96.8-98.2] SCREEN: Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
[L069 98.2-102.8] SCREEN: Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
[L070 98.2-102.8] ACTION: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.
[L071 98.5-102.4] LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Proud): "I may leave this chapel without a husband..."
[L072 102.8-110.0] SCREEN: Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.
[L073 103.0-107.4] LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit): "...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed."
[L074 107.4-110.0] ACTION: Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}
